# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 5 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_005_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 5

**5:1** The following day, Joachim brought his offerings to the temple, reasoning to himself: "If the Lord God is favorable to me, the frontlet of the priest will reveal it to me." He presented his gifts and watched intently as the priest went up to the altar of the Lord, scrutinizing the frontlet. He saw no sign of sin reflected there. So Joachim said: "Now I know that the Lord God has shown favor to me and forgiven all my sins."

**5:2** He descended from the temple of the Lord having been justified, and he returned to his house.

**5:3** When Anna's months were completed, she gave birth in the ninth month. She asked the midwife: "What have I given birth to?" The midwife answered: "A girl." And Anna said: "My soul is magnified this day." And she laid the child down to rest.

**5:4** When the days of purification were fulfilled, Anna was purified and nursed the child and gave her the name Mary.
